description: This file exports types, functions, and constants related to directory listing helpers and plugins in the plugin SDK, focusing on directory management, adapters, and directory entries.

methods.name: createChannelDirectoryAdapter
methods.description: Creates a new channel directory adapter instance.

methods.name: createEmptyChannelDirectoryAdapter
methods.description: Creates an empty channel directory adapter.

methods.name: emptyChannelDirectoryList
methods.description: Provides a default or empty list of directory entries.

methods.name: nullChannelDirectorySelf
methods.description: Represents a null or self-reference in directory context.

methods.name: applyDirectoryQueryAndLimit
methods.description: Applies query parameters and limits to directory listing operations.

methods.name: collectNormalizedDirectoryIds
methods.description: Collects normalized directory identifiers from sources.

methods.name: createInspectedDirectoryEntriesLister
methods.description: Creates a function to list inspected directory entries.

methods.name: createResolvedDirectoryEntriesLister
methods.description: Creates a function to list resolved directory entries.

methods.name: listDirectoryEntriesFromSources
methods.description: Lists directory entries from various sources.

methods.name: listDirectoryGroupEntriesFromMapKeys
methods.description: Lists directory group entries using map keys.

methods.name: listDirectoryGroupEntriesFromMapKeysAndAllowFrom
methods.description: Lists directory group entries with allowed sources.

methods.name: listInspectedDirectoryEntriesFromSources
methods.description: Lists inspected directory entries from sources.

methods.name: listResolvedDirectoryEntriesFromSources
methods.description: Lists resolved directory entries from sources.

methods.name: listResolvedDirectoryGroupEntriesFromMapKeys
methods.description: Lists resolved directory group entries from map keys.

methods.name: listResolvedDirectoryUserEntriesFromAllowFrom
methods.description: Lists resolved directory user entries with allowed sources.

methods.name: listDirectoryUserEntriesFromAllowFrom
methods.description: Lists directory user entries from allowed sources.

methods.name: listDirectoryUserEntriesFromAllowFromAndMapKeys
methods.description: Lists directory user entries with allowed sources and map keys.

methods.name: toDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Converts raw data to directory entry format.

methods.description: Inspects a read-only channel account details.
